description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/ListNow. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Retries a failed pending publication or submits a pending product now. Domain: listings. Entity: pending_listing. Operation: retry_or_publish. Scope: current_store. State: pending. RequiredInputs: confirmed. ownerAgent: publication. SupportingAgents: listings, support. AllowedIntents: retry_pending_publication, publish_pending_listing. ReadOnly: false. RequiresConfirmation: true. RequiresChannel: true. Use when: The user asks to retry or resubmit an existing pending product after fixing a marketplace error, or explicitly asks to publish a pending product now. Use this action instead of telling the user to click Retry in HGRWeb. SearchTerms: retry pending listing, retry publishing, publish pending listing now, resubmit pending product, retry failed publication, retry ebay publication. NegativeUseCases: Do not retry automatically merely because the user asks what the error means; Do not use for relisting an active or terminated product. Input: [FromBody] rq: Request.ListNowRequest. Id is the first variation ID, not its parent ListingId. Resolve the attached product or GetPending listingId through Listing/GetListings with ListingIds and Projection=Identifiers in the selected channel, then use variations[0].id, as HGRWeb Retry does. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: BaseResponse.Success reports whether the retry or scheduling request was accepted, not whether marketplace publication has completed. Search terms: searchproduct listnow. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
